content.text:
The quest "Down into Vicrium" is finished and the game has taken my notes.

I got the knights' strongbox map from the lower galleries and brought it back to Helstrom. Ah-Zish's key never worked. Persuasion and the 100 gold both returned a "gives the key" line, but no key reached my pack and my gold stayed at 750. The door also refused a lockpick, so I went round through the old adit and found the strongbox that way.

Nesh-Deeka named me Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker, the order's second rank, and paid 200 gold. I chose the rapier. She sent me on to her officer Never-Writes-Twice, who recognised the tooth-shaped crag on the map. It is the Grey Tooth, the seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha. She also warned me about Cuts-the-Old-Knot, a former member who went mad on sap and killed her minders.

I still don't know what the Root and the Eye of Argonia are, how the order "listens", or why the Unbound seal trees. The seven towers on the map are also unexplained. Next would be Skeith Isle, the Unbound, or the Collector Ennodius Vanin.
